definitions: If someone has the desire and determination to achieve something, they will find a method or means to do so, regardless of obstacles.
Strong determination can overcome any obstacle.
examples: Don't give up on your dream; where there's a will there's a way.
It seemed impossible, but she proved that where there's a will there's a way.
lemma: where there's a will there's a way
source: where there's a will there's a way
